subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: The Case for Automation
description: A fast breakdown of The Case for Automation for builders.

hook.text: A team runs 500 manual tests before every release. It takes three people an entire week each time.

buildup.text: They calculate the yearly cost: thousands of person-hours clicking the same buttons repeatedly.

discovery.text: Automation runs those 500 tests in twenty minutes, freeing the team for exploratory work.

twist.text: The real value isn't speed—testers now find novel bugs instead of re-checking old ones.

climax.text: Manual testing found two new bugs per cycle. After automating regression, they find twelve.

punchline.text: Automate the repetitive. Free humans for the creative.

quiz.question: What is the biggest benefit of test automation?
options: Freeing testers for creative exploratory work
